text: Egypt has very **sparse coverage**. The entirety of the coverage is in Generation 3, made with a trekker camera. Trekkers can be recognized by the fact that the camera is lower to the ground, having smaller blurs, and no car shadow.

Instead of learning a lot of country-specific clues, it is more practical to simply memorise what the trekkers look like. There are seven sections of coverage, each centred around historic places of interest, ranging from the Pyramids to Coptic churches and medieval citadels.
The coverage is limited to two general areas:
- Cairo: four trekkers.
- Alexandria: three trekkers, two of which are fairly far outside the city to its southwest (Monastery of Saint Mina and nearby archeological excavations).
text_zh: 埃及的**街景覆蓋非常稀疏**。所有的街景覆蓋都屬於第三代（Generation 3），是由徒步拍攝相機所拍攝。徒步拍攝的特徵是相機離地面較近、模糊範圍較小，且沒有車影。
與其去記大量特定國家的線索，不如直接記住徒步拍攝相機的外觀還比較實際。這裡共有七段街景覆蓋，每段都以歷史名勝為中心，從金字塔到科普特教堂和中世紀城堡應有盡有。
街景覆蓋僅限於兩個大致區域：
- 開羅：四個徒步拍攝點。
- 亞歷山大：三個徒步拍攝點，其中兩個位在城市西南方的郊區外圍（聖米納修道院及附近的考古發掘區）。

text: Many of the buildings you see in the trekker coverage are made of **sandstone**.
text_zh: 你在徒步拍攝街景中看到的許多建築都是由**砂岩**建成。

text: The official language in Egypt is **Arabic**. You can occasionally see it on signs in several of the trekkers. Its script can be identified by its lines and dots.
text_zh: 埃及的官方語言是**阿拉伯語**。你偶爾可以在幾個徒步拍攝點的標誌上看到它。其文字可以透過線條和點來辨識。

text: The great **pyramids of Giza** have trekker coverage.
NOTE: This is not to be confused with the pyramid in [Memphis](https://goo.gl/maps/GjibrhtPwBHG4Z749), which is made of glass instead of sand stone.
text_zh: 偉大的**吉薩金字塔群**擁有徒步拍攝街景。
注意：這不應與[孟斐斯](https://goo.gl/maps/GjibrhtPwBHG4Z749)的金字塔混淆，該金字塔是用玻璃建造而非砂岩。

text: The coverage inside the valley temple of Khafre can be recognised by the rows of massive **square pillars**.
text_zh: 卡夫拉河谷神廟內部的街景可以透過一排排巨大的**方形石柱**來識別。

text: The Djoser pyramid, which can be recognised by the **stair-like sections** combined with the scaffolding surrounding it, is located south of Cairo. You can also find some other minor historical [excavation sites](https://goo.gl/maps/7BqQiweSuJNymHtk9) and some plain [desert coverage](https://goo.gl/maps/rGjL8b1VSXDGGyck7).
text_zh: 左塞爾金字塔（Djoser pyramid）位於開羅南部，其特徵是**階梯狀的結構**結合了周圍的鷹架。你也可以找到其他較小的歷史[發掘遺址](https://goo.gl/maps/7BqQiweSuJNymHtk9)以及一些平坦的[沙漠街景](https://goo.gl/maps/rGjL8b1VSXDGGyck7)。

text: The **Cairo Citadel** is an enormous fortification with a trekker walking through and around it. It can be recognized by its massive walls that are made of clean-cut sandstone blocks.
text_zh: **開羅城堡**是一座巨大的要塞，有徒步拍攝街景在其內部及周圍穿梭。其特徵是由俐落的砂岩方塊所砌成的巨大城牆。

text: Inside the Citadel, you can see the Ottoman-era [**Mosque of Muhammad Ali**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mosque_of_Muhammad_Ali). It has light grey domes and very tall minarets.
NOTE: This mosque looks superficially similar to the [Hagia Sophia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hagia_Sophia) mosque in Istanbul.
text_zh: 在城堡內部，你可以看到鄂圖曼帝國時期的[**穆罕默德·阿里清真寺**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mosque_of_Muhammad_Ali)。它擁有淺灰色的圓頂和非常高聳的宣禮塔。
注意：這座清真寺從外觀上看來與伊斯坦堡的[聖索菲亞大教堂](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hagia_Sophia)清真寺有些相似。

text: The trekker in and around the [Hanging Church](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hanging_Church) consists of two parts that look fairly different from each other.

Outside the church, the trekker is walking around a **normal urban Cairo street**. At most points, you will still see the church complex, its spires with crosses, and historic sandstone walls. But you will also see apartment buildings, shops, and normal pedestrian traffic.
_This trekker can be found just east of Giza, near the map label Fustat._
text_zh: [懸空教堂](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hanging_Church)內部與周邊的徒步拍攝由兩個看起來截然不同的部分組成。
在教堂外面，徒步拍攝相機正走在一條**開羅的普通市區街道**上。在多數視角下，你依然會看到教堂建築群、帶有十字架的尖頂以及歷史悠久的砂岩牆。但你也會看到公寓大樓、商店和正常的行人交通。
_這個徒步拍攝點位在吉薩正東方，靠近地圖標籤福斯塔特（Fustat）。_

text: At a certain point, the trekker moves from the street into the Hanging Church. Inside, you will see a **beautiful courtyard** with religious mosaics and two white church spires.
text_zh: 在某個時間點，徒步拍攝從街道轉入懸空教堂內部。在裡面，你會看到一個**美麗的中庭**，帶有宗教馬賽克裝飾和兩座白色的教堂尖頂。

text: The Qaitbay Citadel consists of a **large castle** surrounded by thick walls, which are both made of **sandstone**.
text_zh: 蓋特拜城堡（Qaitbay Citadel）由一座**大型城堡**組成，周圍環繞著厚實的城牆，兩者皆由**砂岩**製成。

text: The monastery complex of Saint Mina consists of several large, palace-like buildings in a somewhat modern, Arabic style. Most of the buildings have several **spires** crowned with **Christian crosses**.
text_zh: 聖米納修道院建築群由幾棟大型、宮殿式的建築組成，帶有某種現代的阿拉伯風格。大多數建築都有好幾個頂部飾有**基督教十字架**的**尖頂**。

text: The Abu Mena Heritage Site is a **major excavation area** southwest of Alexandria, just south of the Saint Mina monastery. In the middle of the site, you can find a small, yellow [wooden chapel](https://goo.gl/maps/6SHCGFrbm1nTPdWDA).
text_zh: 阿布梅納遺址（Abu Mena Heritage Site）是位於亞歷山大西南方、聖米納修道院正南方的一個**大型發掘區**。在遺址中央，你可以找到一座黃色的小型[木造禮拜堂](https://goo.gl/maps/6SHCGFrbm1nTPdWDA)。
